svg.text: How the host learns about, loads, and replaces any extension it was never built against
descriptor { id, label, routePath, component, useStore }
fired by FileSystemWatcher on any add, remove, or rebuild
remoteEntry.js is not content-hashed, so the ?t= query string is what defeats the module cache
